title: Tenant checkout flow
description: Close a tenancy agreement: move-out date, deposit settlement (deduct damages, log refund amount), bed released back to VACANT.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout requires a move-out date and shows deposit vs deductions
Bed becomes VACANT immediately after checkout
Tenant's history remains viewable after checkout (status VACATED, not deleted)

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. Scope note: the wireframe (Rent5_Checkout) has an optional 'reason' field alongside the damage deduction amount, but TenancyAgreement has no column to persist it (DESIGN.md section 3 schema is authoritative) - dropping that field rather than inventing a schema change; a future note-taking ticket (LODGY-24) could log a DAMAGE-type TenantNote instead, but that's out of this ticket's scope. Not coercing a negative refund to zero if deductions exceed the deposit - showing the real computed number is more honest than hiding an over-deduction.

Added TenancyAgreementRepository.getActiveByTenantId/close and TenantRepository.setVacated. Built CheckoutViewModel/CheckoutScreen (move-out date via Material3 DatePicker, deposit shown against a damage-deduction field, live-computed refund), reachable from a 'Checkout tenant' action on TenantProfileScreen (only shown while status==ACTIVE). confirmCheckout() does all three writes in one coroutine: closes the agreement (moveOutDate, depositRefundAmount, status=CLOSED), calls bedRepository.setVacant, and sets the tenant's own status to VACATED - then pops back to the Tenants tab. AC1: move-out date is a required field defaulting to today (DatePicker, no restriction), deposit vs deduction vs computed refund all shown together. AC2: setVacant runs synchronously in the same save, and BedGridScreen reads a live Flow so it reflects VACANT immediately on next view - same reasoning as LODGY-13. AC3: checkout never deletes the Tenant row, only flips status - TenantProfileScreen and the directory's VACATED chip both keep working afterward. This also closes LODGY-9's AC2 in full (onboarding half from LODGY-13, checkout half from this) - moving that ticket to Testing too. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still queued.
